source: NASA/CXC/GSFC/S.A. Walker et al. (X-ray, processed to bring out the wave); NASA Image Library GSFC_20171208_Archive_e000078, 'Gigantic Wave Discovered in Perseus Galaxy Cluster'; public domain (NASA)
shows: Chandra X-rays (false colour), edge-enhanced: the filaments and the wave are drawn out by a gradient filter; a plain X-ray image is a smooth glow
steps: square crop centred on the cluster, 1024 px; soft round fade to black at the edge (bullet 0.30-0.48, pandora's 0.26-0.47 of the width; Perseus fades by itself); then the luminous transparency pass (node scripts/generate-icon-resolutions.mjs <slug> then node scripts/unscreen-icons.mjs <slug>)
